yaml.description-meta: How to reach Kamil Gacek at AGH University of Krakow.

markdown.markdown:
The fastest way to reach me is by e-mail. I am happy to hear from potential collaborators,
about research visits and joint projects, and from students with questions about my courses.


::: {.linklist}
- [E-mail]{.linklist-label} [kgacek@agh.edu.pl](mailto:kgacek@agh.edu.pl)
- [Department]{.linklist-label} Department of Applications of Mathematics in Economics
- [Faculty]{.linklist-label} Faculty of Management
- [University]{.linklist-label} AGH University of Krakow
- [Address]{.linklist-label} al. Mickiewicza 30, 30-059 Krakow, Poland
:::

## Profiles

::: {.linklist}
- [[]{.bi .bi-linkedin .profile-icon}[LinkedIn]{.linklist-label}](https://www.linkedin.com/in/kamil-gacek/)
- [[]{.ai .ai-google-scholar .profile-icon}[Google Scholar]{.linklist-label}](https://scholar.google.com/citations?user=Bo11EggAAAAJ&hl=pl)
- [[]{.ai .ai-researchgate .profile-icon}[Research Gate]{.linklist-label}](https://www.researchgate.net/profile/Kamil-Gacek-2)
- [[]{.ai .ai-orcid .profile-icon}[ORCID]{.linklist-label}](https://orcid.org/0009-0002-0235-3232)
:::

## For students

Office hours are held during the semester at the Faculty of Management; the current schedule
is announced on the AGH course pages. Questions about assignments, quizzes and exams are
welcome by e-mail.
